payload.label: generic-rollback-tool
findings: This release ships a single-environment deploy with health-gated fix-forward (roll-forward) convergence.
Rollback / auto-rollback is a post-release capability and is not advertised or actuated.
The rollback code is retained but gated; it stays off unless `HONUA_DEVOPS_EXPERIMENTAL_ROLLBACK` is explicitly enabled.
Recover by rolling FORWARD: diagnose the failing signal, propose a corrected revision, and re-deploy through the governed create path (deploy_service_gitops / propose operation).
